title: Sing Joyfully to the LORD
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, a joyful gathering of ancient Israelites in an open courtyard surrounded by limestone buildings. Musicians tune lyres, prepare simple stringed instruments, and hold hand drums while men, women, and children gather to sing praise to the LORD. David stands near the musicians, encouraging the congregation to sing a new song skillfully and with joy. Their expressions show sincere gratitude rather than performance for an audience. Nearby, an honest merchant measures grain fairly, a farmer shares produce with a neighbor, and a respected elder listens carefully to a dispute, reflecting the psalm's celebration of the LORD's word as upright and His work as faithful. The courtyard opens toward a broad landscape of cultivated fields, olive groves, and distant hills. The light is bright and natural, conveying that the earth is full of the LORD's goodness and that righteousness and justice are not abstract ideas but qualities reflected in His dealings with the world. Use historically plausible Israelite instruments, wool and linen garments, woven baskets, and realistic stonework. No modern instruments, stage lights, readable text, or fantasy imagery.

title: The Heavens Were Made by the Word of the LORD
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism with a majestic landscape extending from the waters to the heavens. In the foreground, the calm surface of a large body of water reflects clouds, rocky banks, and birds moving above it. Beyond the shoreline, deep valleys, mountains, cultivated land, and distant settlements spread across the horizon. A small group of Israelites stands on a hill watching the vastness of creation in reverent silence. David looks toward the sky, contemplating the psalm's declaration that the heavens were made by the word of the LORD and the host of heaven by the breath of His mouth. The visual composition should express divine command and order without showing a physical divine figure or illustrating creation as a modern scientific diagram. In the distance, several rulers and advisers consult over a plan, their gathering visually small in comparison with the landscape, showing that human counsel cannot overturn the LORD's purpose. A peaceful Israelite settlement occupies a fertile valley, representing the blessing of a people whose God is the LORD. Natural light, realistic water and mountains, historically plausible clothing. No modern buildings, diagrams, captions, or fantasy effects.

title: Our Soul Waits for the LORD
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, an ancient Israelite family stands on a terrace overlooking a town and its surrounding farmland. Parents, children, an older relative, and a shepherd pause together beneath the open sky, reflecting that the LORD looks from heaven and observes all humanity. In the distance, a group of soldiers prepares horses and chariots, while a neighboring household counts stored grain; neither military strength nor material wealth should dominate the composition. The family instead gathers close in quiet prayer, placing their hope in the LORD as their help and shield. David stands among them, teaching by example that a king cannot be saved by a large army alone and that strength is not measured merely by the power of a horse. The mood is thoughtful and peaceful, with a sense of trust despite uncertainty about the future. A gentle morning light reaches the faces of the family, symbolizing their hope in God's steadfast love. Ancient Near Eastern livestock, realistic chariots in the distance, simple Israelite garments, stone terraces, and cultivated fields. No modern weapons, vehicles, readable writing, or supernatural imagery.

title: I Will Bless the LORD at All Times
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, David gathers with a small group of worshippers in a modest courtyard in ancient Israel. He speaks and sings with sincere humility, inviting those in need to hear of the LORD's goodness and join in praise. The setting should evoke the psalm's historical heading concerning David's escape from danger by pretending to be insane before Abimelech, without staging an elaborate invented scene or portraying David as mocking God. Instead, include a subtle flashback-like view through an open archway: David once stood in a foreign ruler's courtyard amid uncertain guards and unfamiliar architecture, using unusual behavior to escape immediate danger. In the present scene, he is safe among fellow worshippers, explaining that he sought the LORD and was delivered from his fears. A vulnerable traveler listens closely while an elder offers a place to sit. A shaft of ordinary sunlight illuminates the small gathering, symbolizing the angel of the LORD encamping around those who fear Him. Do not depict a visible angel or supernatural protection as a literal military formation. Historically plausible ancient garments, stone architecture, oil lamps, and subdued natural light. No modern objects, text, or fantasy effects.

title: Taste and See That the LORD Is Good
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, a welcoming meal in an ancient Israelite household. A family shares fresh bread, olives, fruit, and a clay cup of water, inviting a weary traveler to sit among them. The host gestures warmly toward the food, visually expressing the invitation to taste and see that the LORD is good. A young listener watches an older relative explain that true reverence for God shapes daily conduct. Nearby, two neighbors resolve a disagreement through honest words rather than insults, while a young man walks away from an opportunity to cheat a customer. These everyday actions represent the instruction to keep the tongue from evil, speak truthfully, depart from evil, do good, seek peace, and pursue it. The meal is simple and generous, not lavish, showing that God's goodness can be recognized through humble provision and faithful living. Use realistic ancient food, earthenware, woven mats, wool garments, and limestone architecture. Warm light should create an inviting atmosphere without implying that prosperity is guaranteed to every faithful person. No modern dishes, appliances, readable captions, or fantasy effects.

title: The LORD Is Near to the Brokenhearted
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, a modest ancient Israelite settlement where a distressed family receives compassionate attention from its neighbors. One person sits quietly near a doorway, visibly grieving but treated with dignity; an older friend sits beside them and listens without judgment. Another neighbor brings a small basket of food and a vessel of water. In the background, a dishonest man walks away from an unresolved dispute while a truthful witness gives an account to a respected elder. These contrasting actions convey the psalm's teaching that the LORD's eyes are upon the righteous, that He hears their cries, and that He opposes evil. Beyond the houses, a safe path leads toward the hills, while dark clouds gather over a distant barren ridge. The clouds suggest adversity, not a specific divine attack. A small lamp shines inside the doorway, symbolizing hope for the brokenhearted and crushed in spirit. Include the psalm's assurance that the LORD redeems the lives of His servants and that those who take refuge in Him are not condemned, without implying that faithful people never suffer. Ancient clothing, stone houses, natural light, realistic expressions. No graphic injury, modern objects, or fantasy effects.

title: Contend, O LORD, with Those Who Contend with Me
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, David stands in a rugged valley while adversaries gather on a distant ridge and near a narrow path. The scene conveys a plea for divine defense rather than showing David initiating an attack. He turns toward the heavens with a serious expression, asking the LORD to take up his cause, protect him with shield and buckler imagery, and stand against those who pursue him unjustly. Near the foreground, a fallen snare and a concealed pit represent the traps his enemies have prepared. No person is shown falling into a trap or suffering injury. A sturdy rock shelter behind David symbolizes refuge, while the adversaries remain across the ravine, separated from him by difficult terrain. The composition should express the distress of being targeted without cause and the prayer that evil schemes will fail and return upon those who secretly planned them. Use plausible ancient Israelite weapons and clothing in the far background, rocky Judean scenery, natural cloud light, and restrained expressions. No graphic violence, modern weaponry, literal supernatural warrior, or fantasy effects.

title: They Rejoiced When I Stumbled, but I Mourned for Them
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, a public courtyard in an ancient Israelite town during a tense dispute. David stands apart from a group of men who accuse him and exchange hostile looks. Some appear pleased by his difficulty, while others gesture sarcastically or whisper to people passing by. The composition should show the contrast between their hostility and David's earlier concern for others: in a smaller foreground moment, he kneels beside a sick or grieving neighbor, offering comfort and prayer, remembering how he mourned and fasted for people even when they did not reciprocate his compassion. Keep the ill person covered with simple cloth and show no medical or graphic detail. In the present scene, David's face expresses hurt and bewilderment rather than a desire for personal revenge. A few honest witnesses stand nearby, reluctant to join the mockery. Historically plausible tunics, woven cloaks, stone benches, and market goods provide the setting. The panel should capture betrayal, ingratitude, and unjust ridicule while preserving the humanity of all characters. No modern objects, captions, or graphic violence.

title: Rescue My Soul from Their Destructions
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, David kneels at the edge of an ancient settlement, pleading with God not to remain silent while hostile men gather in the public square and exchange false accusations. A small group of witnesses gestures toward David while speaking with confidence, although their accounts contradict each other. David's trusted companion stands beside him but does not interrupt, allowing the seriousness of the appeal to remain visible. A few honest onlookers watch uneasily, recognizing that the accused man's treatment is unfair. The city gate and open road in the background represent the wider community that hears and repeats these accusations. David raises his eyes toward the sky, asking to be delivered from those who rejoice over his trouble and speak against him without cause. The scene should focus on false accusation and the plea for justice, not on an invented trial or physical attack. Use ancient Israelite garments, rough stone walls, clay jars, and believable facial expressions. No written accusations, modern courtroom objects, or graphic details.

title: Let the LORD Be Magnified
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, a gathering of ordinary Israelites and elders near the gate of an ancient city after a tense public dispute. David stands before the group, asking the LORD to judge rightly and not allow his enemies to celebrate a false victory. Several witnesses listen attentively, while those who previously mocked him stand farther back, their confident expressions subdued. A poor neighbor and an elderly woman speak in David's support, showing that the cause of justice matters to the whole community. In the background, worshippers begin to gather for thanksgiving, with one musician carrying a lyre and another preparing a simple drum. The composition should transition from the seriousness of the appeal for a just verdict toward the promise of joyful praise, especially the declaration that the LORD delights in the peace of His servant. David's final expression is resolute and grateful, not vindictive. Authentic ancient architecture, realistic woven garments, and natural late-afternoon light. Do not portray the enemies suffering or invent a divine verdict delivered in a visible supernatural form. No modern objects, text, or fantasy effects.

title: The Deceit of the Wicked Heart
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, a narrow street in an ancient Israelite town where a wealthy and influential man moves through public life with a respectable outward appearance. He greets a neighbor courteously, but when the neighbor leaves, he exchanges a secret signal with an associate and begins planning a dishonest transaction. At a nearby table, he studies goods and weights while a poorer tradesman waits for a fair price. The wealthy man's face should convey self-deception and the absence of reverence for God rather than cartoonish evil. In an adjacent quiet courtyard, David sits thoughtfully in prayer, reflecting on the way wickedness whispers within the heart and how the proud person flatters himself instead of recognizing wrongdoing. A narrow alley grows dark behind the dishonest man, symbolizing the path of mischief and the refusal to reject evil even at night. Show realistic market goods, stone walls, simple scales, woven baskets, and ancient clothing. The image should not imply that wealth alone signifies wickedness. No modern money, signs, readable text, or fantasy elements.

title: Your Mercy, O LORD, Reaches to the Heavens
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, an expansive sunrise over an ancient Israelite valley with a clear stream flowing between cultivated fields and rocky hills. In the foreground, a shepherd leads sheep toward green pasture while a family draws water and fills clay jars. The scene conveys the richness of God's steadfast love, faithfulness, righteousness, and judgments through the natural landscape: high mountains rise beyond the valley, deep clouds drift across the sky, and the river sustains people and animals. David stands on a ridge looking across the land in quiet gratitude, acknowledging that both humanity and animals are preserved by God's care. A shaded tree beside the flowing water provides rest for travelers, symbolizing the shelter and delight found under the shadow of God's wings. Near the water, a small gathering shares food and welcomes a tired traveler, expressing that the fountain of life and divine light are sources of sustenance and guidance. In a distant lane, a proud oppressor is separated from the peaceful gathering, suggesting the psalm's final hope that evil will not finally prevail. Use authentic ancient terrain, animals, garments, and natural lighting. No modern infrastructure, text, or fantasy effects.

title: Fret Not Yourself Because of Evildoers
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, a peaceful agricultural valley in ancient Israel with two contrasting groups visible in the same broad composition. On one side, a prosperous but dishonest landholder supervises workers and appears confident because his fields are productive. On the other side, a humble farmer tends a smaller plot, trusts God, and carries out his tasks honestly. David stands beside the humble farmer, speaking calmly and encouraging him not to be consumed by envy of those who prosper through wrongdoing. The farmer's field includes young green shoots, a simple irrigation channel, a stone boundary, and a small shade tree. In the background, another family shares food with a neighbor, illustrating trust in the LORD, doing good, delighting in Him, and committing one's way to Him. The dishonest man's temporary prosperity should not be represented as proof of divine favor; subtle uncertainty in his neglected boundary and hurried gestures contrasts with the faithful farmer's steadiness. Show ancient Israelite clothing, realistic agricultural tools, stone terraces, and warm early-morning light. No modern machinery, captions, or fantasy effects.

title: The Meek Shall Inherit the Earth
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, a public gathering in an ancient Israelite village where tempers have begun to rise over land, water, and market disputes. One influential man speaks angrily and clenches his hands, while a humble neighbor refuses to return insult for insult. David stands beside the calmer man, encouraging patience, the release of anger, and confidence that wrongdoing will not endure forever. Nearby, children walk safely between family homes and a shared well, representing the peace that becomes possible when people refuse to be driven by fury. In the distance, an imposing but neglected house belonging to a corrupt landholder stands beside a field that has gone untended, while a smaller but well-cared-for home sits among productive olive trees. The contrast should illustrate the passing nature of evil and the promised peace of the meek, not suggest that wealth or poverty alone identifies a person's moral standing. Use realistic ancient clothing, stone walls, water jars, olive groves, and soft daylight. No graphic conflict, modern objects, text, or fantasy elements.

title: The LORD Upholds the Righteous
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, a modest village street in ancient Israel where a dishonest man has become angry with a righteous neighbor who will not participate in his schemes. The dishonest man speaks harshly and gestures toward the neighbor's small home, while the neighbor remains composed and refuses to escalate the conflict. Nearby, an elder helps settle a dispute over a field boundary, demonstrating that the truly secure community depends on justice, not intimidation. In the wider landscape, fertile plots belonging to several households contrast with a neglected field where grain has dried and weeds have spread. A prosperous oppressor's household appears grand but unstable, while humble families share their provisions and continue their work. The image should visualize the psalm's contrast between the weapons and schemes of the wicked and the enduring inheritance of the righteous, as well as the assurance that God knows their days and upholds them in difficult times. Avoid a literal supernatural strike or graphic destruction. Historically plausible tools, modest homes, wool clothing, realistic plants, and natural light. No modern objects, captions, or fantasy imagery.

title: The Righteous Are Generous and Their Steps Are Established
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, a humble Israelite household opens its courtyard to neighbors during a season of need. A man who owes a debt but struggles to repay it speaks honestly with his creditor; the creditor, recognizing the hardship, chooses mercy rather than exploiting him. Nearby, a righteous family distributes bread and grain to a poorer household, showing the psalm's contrast between the wicked who borrow and fail to repay and the righteous who show generosity. David observes the exchange with a thoughtful expression. An older man walks along the path, supported by his younger relative, reflecting that the LORD establishes the steps of those who delight in His way and does not abandon them. The setting includes a modest stone house, an olive tree, baskets of grain, a grinding stone, and a clear view of the village path. The emotional tone should be grounded in practical kindness and steady faith, not unrealistic abundance. Ancient Israelite clothing, natural textures, believable agricultural details, and warm daylight. No modern currency, paperwork, or fantasy effects.

title: Depart from Evil and Dwell Securely
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, a village street and nearby field in ancient Israel where the moral contrast between two households is evident through their everyday conduct. One family works honestly, feeds an elderly neighbor, and keeps a promise despite inconvenience. In the opposite courtyard, a wealthy man conspires with an associate to take advantage of another household, speaking secretly while concealing a small pouch. An upright elder refuses to support the dishonest plan and gives truthful testimony at the village gate. David stands nearby, encouraging people to depart from evil, do good, and trust the LORD's concern for justice. A narrow path leads from the gate toward a secure settlement, suggesting that the LORD does not abandon the righteous to the power of those who accuse them. The dishonest man's gaze follows David uneasily, symbolizing that schemes cannot establish lasting security. Do not portray the righteous as immune to every accusation or hardship; emphasize the conviction that God will not finally abandon them. Realistic ancient garments, stone houses, market baskets, and natural light. No modern objects, visible writing, or fantasy elements.

title: The Future of the Wicked and the Salvation of the Righteous
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, a broad valley in ancient Israel viewed from a hillside at sunrise. In the foreground, David walks with a small group of younger Israelites, pointing toward two contrasting settlements. One prosperous man's estate once appeared magnificent, but its courtyard is now empty and its neglected garden is overgrown. In the other direction, a modest village continues to thrive through honest work, shared provision, and peaceful community life. The younger listeners study the contrast as David explains the importance of waiting for the LORD, keeping His way, and observing the outcome of both wickedness and integrity. The abandoned estate should look naturally neglected, not destroyed by a visible supernatural force. The modest settlement is not wealthy but secure and peaceful, symbolizing the integrity, refuge, and salvation described in the psalm. Include olive trees, terraced fields, stone walls, realistic garments, and golden morning light. The scene should emphasize that deliverance comes from the LORD and that He is the strength of the righteous in times of trouble. No modern ruins, captions, or fantasy effects.

title: O LORD, Do Not Rebuke Me in Your Anger
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, a quiet room in an ancient Israelite dwelling where David sits in deep distress. His face appears weary, and his posture communicates grief, weakness, and regret. A simple walking staff leans against a wall, while a bowl of water and folded cloth rest beside his mat. He is not shown with graphic injuries or a specific disease; the scene should express the psalm's language of burden, bodily distress, and inward turmoil through his lowered gaze and heavy shoulders. A shaft of sunlight enters through a narrow opening, illuminating the dust in the air while much of the room remains in shadow. David raises one hand toward the heavens in prayer, asking the LORD not to discipline him in anger. His expression also suggests the weight of guilt and the feeling that distress has become too heavy to bear alone. Historically plausible stone walls, woven bedding, oil lamp, and linen clothing. No modern medical equipment, graphic symptoms, or supernatural imagery.

title: I Wait for You, O LORD
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, David sits in the courtyard of his home, physically tired and emotionally troubled. A few friends stand at a respectful distance, unsure how to respond, while some people passing outside avoid his gaze. Others who once appeared close to him have withdrawn, representing the isolation described in the psalm. David looks upward in prayer, acknowledging that his sighing is not hidden from God and that his heart longs for help. On the ground nearby lie a walking staff and a cloak, while his hands remain open in the posture of someone waiting quietly rather than arguing with every accusation. The scene should convey that he chooses not to retaliate or speak rashly, trusting the LORD to answer. Beyond the courtyard gate, a calm path stretches toward the hills, symbolizing patient waiting for deliverance. Avoid depicting the friends as cruel caricatures or specifying a cause of illness. Authentic ancient clothing, realistic expressions, stone architecture, and natural afternoon light. No modern objects, text, or graphic details.

title: Do Not Forsake Me, O LORD
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, David kneels beside a stone wall at evening, confessing his distress and asking the LORD not to forsake him. His expression conveys sorrow over his own wrongdoing and the additional pain of being opposed by people who repay good with evil. In the background, two men who once received help from David now speak against him, while another neighbor quietly refuses to join their accusations. David does not confront them or seek revenge; he remains in prayer and asks for swift help from the LORD, his salvation. An oil lamp burns beside an open doorway, and the final light of the day falls on the road leading away from the settlement. The mood is vulnerable and honest, portraying both repentance and the hope of divine companionship. Avoid showing a visible God, a literal dramatic rescue, or graphic illness. Use historically plausible Israelite clothing, clay lamps, worn stone, and natural dusk lighting. No modern objects, captions, or fantasy effects.

title: Teach Me the Measure of My Days
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, David stands silently at the edge of an ancient Israelite marketplace, consciously choosing not to respond angrily to the provocation of a dishonest man. His lips are pressed together and his expression reveals inward struggle as he tries to guard his speech. In a nearby courtyard, a potter works clay on a simple wheel, shaping a vessel while a child watches; this ordinary activity serves as a quiet reminder of the brevity and fragility of human life. David later steps away from the market and sits beside a stone wall, looking toward the distant hills and asking God to teach him the measure of his days. Around him, townspeople move through their daily work, their shadows lengthening as the sun lowers. A merchant's piles of goods occupy the foreground but appear small beneath the broad sky, representing how people bustle about without knowing the duration or true weight of their lives. The image should be contemplative, not bleak. Historically plausible clay pottery, robes, stone streets, natural sunlight, no modern clocks, written captions, or fantasy effects.

title: My Hope Is in You
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, David sits alone beside a small oil lamp in a modest stone dwelling during the final light of evening. His face reflects humility as he turns away from confidence in material wealth and places his hope in the LORD. A pouch of coins, a folded cloak, and a clay vessel rest on the table, representing the temporary possessions that cannot secure a person's life. David's hands are open in prayer as he asks for deliverance from his transgressions and for wisdom to live with awareness of human frailty. Beyond the doorway, a traveler passes along the road, emphasizing the psalm's image of human life as a temporary sojourn. David's expression softens as he asks God to hear his prayer, listen to his cry, and look upon his tears. Show the tension between the need for correction and the longing for comfort, without inventing the exact affliction that caused the psalm. Ancient household materials, realistic clothing, warm lamplight against cool dusk, no modern objects, text, or graphic details.

title: He Brought Me Up from the Pit
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, David stands on firm ground beside a rocky pit in an ancient Israelite landscape. The pit is deep enough to suggest danger but is empty of bodies, and a rough path leads up from its shadow toward a broad, stable stretch of ground. David looks down briefly at the dark hollow, then raises his face in gratitude, conveying that he waited patiently for the LORD, was heard, and was brought out of a place of distress. A few companions stand at a respectful distance, relieved but not celebrating violently. A musician holds a lyre nearby, ready to accompany the new song of praise David will offer. Behind the group, a secure trail continues toward a settlement, symbolizing established steps and renewed stability. The image should express rescue and thankfulness while avoiding the claim that the psalm describes one precisely identified event. Use authentic ancient clothing, realistic rock formations, clay vessels, sparse vegetation, and natural sunlight. No modern ropes, rescue equipment, graphic danger, or fantasy effects.

title: I Delight to Do Your Will
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, David stands in an open courtyard before a gathering of Israelites, speaking sincerely about obedience to the LORD. Beside him rests an unrolled scroll, a small oil lamp, and simple vessels associated with worship. The sanctuary entrance is visible in the background, but David's posture makes clear that he is not relying on ceremony alone; he is expressing his delight in doing God's will and keeping God's law within his heart. An ordinary family listens while a poor neighbor receives fair treatment from an elder, showing how obedience and public testimony appear in everyday actions. David speaks openly of God's righteousness, faithfulness, salvation, lovingkindness, and truth before the gathered congregation rather than hiding them within his own heart. The scene should convey sincere proclamation and inward commitment, not a modern lecture or a literal display of words floating in the air. Use plausible Israelite garments, limestone architecture, woven curtains, and natural light. No printed books, modern microphones, readable text, or fantasy effects.

title: Be Pleased to Deliver Me, O LORD
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, David walks through a narrow rocky pass outside an ancient Israelite town, surrounded by steep terrain that leaves few safe routes forward. His expression is urgent and burdened as he asks God not to withhold mercy and to let lovingkindness and truth continually preserve him. Several indistinct hostile figures appear on distant ridges, suggesting real opposition without depicting a specific attack. David pauses beside a large stone outcrop and turns toward the sky in prayer, acknowledging both the troubles that surround him and the weight of his own transgressions. In the distance, a clear road toward a fortified refuge catches the morning light. At the edge of the composition, a small group of humble worshippers looks toward David with concern, reflecting the psalm's contrast between those who seek his harm and those who love God's salvation and rejoice in the LORD. The mood is vulnerable yet hopeful. Historically accurate ancient garments, rocky terrain, natural light, no modern equipment, graphic violence, captions, or fantasy imagery.

title: Blessed Is the One Who Considers the Poor
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, a modest ancient Israelite courtyard where a compassionate household welcomes a poor and weakened traveler. The host brings a clay cup of water and a simple meal while another family member lays a clean woven blanket near a shaded wall. The visitor is treated with dignity rather than pity, and the host listens attentively to his needs. David observes the act of kindness and reflects on the blessing promised to those who consider the poor, trusting that the LORD sustains them in difficult times. In the background, a wealthy passerby watches without stopping, then turns away; another person approaches with sincere concern. A narrow path leads toward the town gate, symbolizing the vulnerable person's need for protection and the psalm's plea for healing and mercy. Avoid presenting poverty as moral failure or depicting a specific illness. Use historically grounded household objects, ancient clothing, realistic expressions, and warm daylight. No modern medical equipment, contemporary money, text, or fantasy effects.

title: Even a Trusted Friend Has Turned Against Me
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, David sits in a quiet room after hearing that people who once ate at his table are speaking against him. One familiar companion stands in the doorway, looking away rather than meeting David's eyes, while another whispers with a visitor outside. The scene conveys betrayal through distance, averted glances, and strained expressions rather than dramatic confrontation. David remains seated near a low table with simple bread and a clay cup, recalling how even a trusted friend shared his meals and yet turned against him. He raises one hand in prayer, asking the LORD to be gracious and raise him up. In the background, an older loyal companion stays nearby, conveying that not all human relationships have failed. A small oil lamp lights David's face, while the stone walls and quiet setting preserve the feeling of personal sorrow. The image should close with David's confidence that the LORD sustains him and with a visual hint of worship and blessing to the God of Israel through all generations. Authentic ancient clothing, food, pottery, and natural lamplight. No modern objects, text, or fantasy effects.
